p: groves: Which were planted contrary to the Law, De 16:21.
quiet before him: He shows that the rest and quietness of kingdoms stands in abolishing idolatry and advancing true religion.
before us: While we have the full government of it.
Ethiopian with an host of a: The king of Ethiopia, or Egypt.
Mareshah: Which was a city in Judah, Jos 15:44 where Michaiah the prophet was born.

let not man prevail against thee: Thus the children of God neither trust in their own power or policy, nor fear the strength and subtilty of their enemies, but consider the cause and see whether their enterprises tend to God's glory, and thereupon assure themselves of the victory by him, who alone is Almighty and can turn all flesh into dust with the breath of his mouth.
fear of the LORD came upon: The Lord had stricken them with fear.
